picks.file: Debrecen, Piac utca a Református Nagytemplomból fotózva. Fortepan 26798.jpg
picks.what: Piac utca from the tower of the Great Reformed Church, photograph (Fortepan)
picks.why: view from a height down the main street, with St. Anne’s Church and the Small Reformed Church towers

gaps: P0–P3: no candidates; P6: nothing of the city center (a forest lookout tower, a ship named Debrecen in Budapest, the BMW plant)
notes: Existing P4 photochrom kept; #2 (colored postcard of the Great Reformed Church, 1905–14) is a fine landmark view but not clearly better and too close in date for a second P4 view. Credit follows Fortepan’s usual form (archive / donor); the donor may not be the photographer.
